messages:
Anya: Quick sync — noticed a couple customers hit weird quota changes when the console toggles the grace-window anchoring. They expect anchoring to stick to the original token, but our flow rebinding to the latest route on first request in the window. Not great.

Raj: Yea saw a spike in support tickets this morning. Looks like tenant A migrated to v2 but the console toggle later bound them back to v1 for some prefixes.

Maria: Can you dump the signal? I want to see telemetry for anchor_type + route_delta.

Sam: Short version: we currently anchor by first request during grace window. Proposal: anchor at token creation time (or console toggle time) so quota + billing are stable. Pros: predictable billing, less surprising route flips. Cons: less flexibility for on-the-fly route decisions (might not pick the best backend).

Lee: If we anchor at token creation, how do we handle tokens minted before rollout? Backfill?

Anya: Two options: 1) retro-anchor existing tokens on opt-in via a console job (fast but mutates history), or 2) leave existing tokens as-is and only apply new anchoring for tokens issued after rollout. Leaning to #2 for safety.

Maria: Telemetry implications: we need to emit anchor_source ("token_creation"|"first_request"|"console_toggle") and route_version on every request so we can diff before/after. Also add a histo for token_rebinds_per_window.

Sam: Agreed. Also add a lightweight probe: sample 0.5% of requests where we simulate alternative anchoring (feature flag) and log what route would have been chosen. No override, just simulation. Helps estimate hit.

Raj: For rollout UX: console should show an affordance that explains anchoring semantics and a preview of how many tokens will change. Something like: "Anchoring will apply to tokens created after the change. Existing tokens unaffected." plus an expandable sample of affected tokens.

Lee: Ops question — if we anchor at token creation, quota accounting must be stable. Make sure we map token -> quota_bucket immutably. Otherwise invoices will diverge.

Anya: Implementation sketch:
```
- Add token.anchor_kind field (enum) set at mint time or via console toggle opt-in API.
- Router reads token.anchor_kind; resolves route_version from mapping at anchor time.
- Emit anchor_kind and effective_route in access logs.
- Sampling probe: router computes alt_route and emits alt_route_tag when flag on.
```

Maria: Example query to validate (debug):
```sql
SELECT anchor_kind, effective_route, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM requests
WHERE tenant = 'example-tenant'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```

Sam: Rollout plan (rough):
- Dev: add token.anchor_kind + router read path (1 week)
- Canary: enable for internal tenants + 1% customers with sampling probe (2 weeks)
- Console: show preview + opt-in toggle (parallel)
- Gradual enable for new tokens; consider migration job for flagged customers (opt-in)

Raj: Alerts/SLIs: if rebind rate > 0.1% after rollout for non-opted tokens, pause rollout. Also watch effective_route_latency delta > 15ms for >5% of p50.

Lee: Do we need a rollback affordance in console? Eg: un-anchor tokens minted after X? Should be possible but gating that behind a safety export and idempotent reverse job.

Anya: Yes. Console should produce an export (CSV of token ids + current anchor) before doing any bulk anchoring changes. Add a confirmation flow and a dry-run mode.

Maria: Telemetry tags to add to dashboards: anchor_kind, rebind_count, alt_route_delta_ms, sample_simulated_route_hit. We'll need a new dashboard tile to show "anchor churn" per tenant over 7d.

Sam: Quick UX copy suggestion for console preview: "Anchoring determines which model/version a token consistently uses during the grace window. Changing anchoring affects routing and quotas for future requests; existing tokens treated per their anchor setting." Keep it short.

Raj: Operational checklist before canary: migration safety test, billing reconciliation smoke test, dashboard widgets, backfill/noop behavior documented.

deploy-bot: Deployed feature-flag:grace_anchor_simulator to staging at 2026-03-20T09:14:12Z :white_check_mark:

Anya: Ok — next actions: Maria add telemetry fields + dashboard mock, Sam prod plan + probe implementation, Raj console preview copy + export job spec, Lee verify billing immutability concerns. I'll own the rollout schedule.

Sam: +1. I'll sketch the probe telemetry schema by EOD. :thumbsup:

Maria: I'll add the dashboard mock to the design doc and tag you all. @Anya @Sam

Lee: I'll run a quick audit on quota_bucket assignment logic and post findings.

Anya: Thanks everyone. If anyone sees more support threads link them here. :sparkles:
